comment: Reference settings for new play lots (docs/next/v3-synthese.md). Copy this file, rename the lot and change the seed: a lot name is never reused. Mix of v3g4-jouer-a plus two entries of v3-jouer-a lost on the way (3 neighbors, surplus on 8 slots); allow_one_plant on every entry (technical: a lower day often leaves a single kind of plant; no play data of its own, watch the share of single-plant grids). Kept: the C1 cleaning and the no_decision reject (C2), both built in; general diversity quotas; at most 2 grids per entry; at most 3 grids on 12 slots. Size caps of v3g6-compact: max_cells 30, max_full_n_rows 1. Out of sample (matin-25, one player, docs/next/v3-criteres-m25.md), 40 cells or more is filler; 30 is a cautious choice, the value played, not a measured threshold (31-39 untested); low cost (20/20 in 213 draws). Dropped: the per-type floors and ceilings, the single-decision and demand-price quotas (no visible effect on the stars, docs/next/v3-criteres-m24.md).
